# اِحْتَطْتَ (iḥtaṭta) /iħ.tatˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْتَاطَ (iḥtāṭa)
# اِحْتَطْتِ (iḥtaṭti) /iħ.tatˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْتَاطَ (iḥtāṭa)
